title: fix(app-shell): disabled Studio and metadata-admin buttons say why on hover, on focus and to assistive tech
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67xTzfGGsgRHTnc1s2B8sber6)_

Fixes #32103
Fixes #32104
Fixes #32105

## 维护者速读

改了什么:Studio 和元数据管理里 6 处「灰掉的按钮」(表单设计器分组上移/下移、各属性面板的上移/下移、对象预览的分组上移/下移、新建对话框的「保存为草稿」、元数据详情页的「保存」)现在都会说明为什么不可用:鼠标悬停、键盘 Tab 聚焦、读屏软件三条路都能拿到原因,做法与 Studio 顶部「发布」按钮一致。
为什么改:原来这些按钮是原生 disabled,键盘跳过、悬停无提示、读屏读不到原因;详情页「保存」还把按钮名字直接换成了原因文字。
风险与回滚:只改显示与可达性,不改任何保存逻辑;按钮可用时外观和行为不变。回滚 = revert 本 PR(三个 commit 各对应一张卡,可单独回退)。
先看:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/_shared.tsx`(新的共享包装 `DisabledControlReason`)→ `ResourceEditPage.tsx`(保存按钮)→ `CreateItemDialog.tsx`。
两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ObjectFormDesigner.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/CreateItemDialog.notDerived-13389.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.positionCreate-13337.test.tsx`,预期全部通过。
需要你做的:无需操作;本 PR 等 domain:ui#3 席位审查后由席位落地。

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

One shared component, `DisabledControlReason`, carries the treatment Studio's header Publish already had: a focusable wrapper `span` that opens a tooltip with the reason, the wrapper and the button both pointing `aria-describedby` at an `sr-only` copy of it, and the button keeping its own name. It renders one element tree whether or not a reason shows, so a button turning on or off is never remounted (a held node and focus survive); without a reason the wrapper is inert (no tab stop, no description, the tooltip never opens). It lives in `metadata-admin/inspectors/_shared.tsx` beside the panel-wide `InspectorReadOnlyReason`, because the reorder pair it fixes is in that file and `studio-design` already imports that module; the package entry exports nothing new. Seat ruling A on the fold (recorded on #32103).

Per card (one commit each):

- **#32103**, the move arrows. The form designer's group arrows ("Already the first group" / "Already the last group"); `InspectorReorderButtons`, the field inspector's "Move up" / "Move down" the card reproduces and every other inspector's pair ("Already first" / "Already last"); and the all-metadata object preview's section arrows in `metadata-admin/previews/ObjectFormCanvas.tsx` ("Already the first section" / "Already the last section"). A reorder pair the host disabled (a read-only inspector) keeps the host's reason and gets none of its own. The reorder pair's disabled arrow drops its `title` (its name, not a reason).
- **#32104**, the create dialog's submit ("Save as draft", "Create", per opener), shared by every Studio create flow: it asks for a display name first, then for an identifier. A submit in flight gives no reason. On a narrow screen the footer's full-width button layout is kept.
- **#32105**, the all-metadata item page's Save: a withheld Save keeps its accessible name "Save" and is described by why ("No changes to save", or the inspector or server refusal holding it); the reason is no longer its `aria-label` and `title`. An enabled Save, and one mid-save, are unchanged (name and tooltip stay the shortcut hint).

Reason strings: 10 new keys in the `studio` namespace catalogues of `@object-ui/i18n` (`namespaces/studio/en.ts`, `zh.ts`), where every string these surfaces read lives. Nothing is added to the eager `locales/*.ts` packs (`locales/en.ts` +0 bytes; `namespaces/studio/en.ts` +557 bytes); no `zh-Hans` edit, so no `zh-Hant` regeneration.

Root changeset: `patch` on `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n`.

## Tests

One pin per card, each driving focus with Tab (`userEvent.tab()`) and checking hover, focus and the accessibility tree, plus a preservation CONTROL:

- #32103: `ObjectFormDesigner.test.tsx` (Tab from the group name reaches each disabled arrow; hover opens the tooltip; CONTROL: a movable arrow is a plain button and still moves), `ObjectFormCanvas.test.tsx` (the first section's up arrow; CONTROL: the second's is plain), `_shared.labels.test.tsx` (`InspectorReorderButtons` at either end; CONTROL: a host-disabled pair carries no boundary reason).
- #32104: `CreateItemDialog.notDerived-13389.test.tsx` (empty dialog: Tab from Cancel reaches the submit's wrapper, which asks for a display name; a name that derives no identifier asks for the identifier; CONTROL: a usable name gives a plain enabled submit that submits).
- #32105: `ResourceEditPage.positionCreate-13337.test.tsx` (an unchanged position: Tab from Cancel reaches the disabled Save, named "Save" and described by "No changes to save"; CONTROL: an enabled Save is unwrapped and keeps the shortcut-hint name).

Existing suites that located a withheld Save by the reason it used to carry as its name, or read the reason from its `title`, now find it by its test id and read the reason from its description (`serverRefusalGate`, `celGate`, `defaultGate`, `requiredInGatedSection-6900`, `schemaAdvisory`, `celHold-27629`, `docEditor-10188`); every assertion is kept. `ObjectFieldInspector.displayPatchReason-28986`'s writable-field CONTROL now expects exactly the reorder pair's own boundary reason, and still no display-patch lock.

## Acceptance notes

- The order's mechanism said to reuse a landed component from #31495. None exists: Publish's wrapper is inline JSX in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, and the components package's `DisabledReasonTrigger` is module-private. Seat ruling A: one shared wrapper used at all six sites; surface widened to `inspectors/_shared.tsx` and its test, and the order's `ObjectFormCanvas.tsx` path corrected to `metadata-admin/previews/`.
- Publish stays the one remaining inline copy of this wrapper (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` is outside this surface). Other inline copies of the same markup, listed and not migrated: `DeclaredActionsBar.tsx`, `FlowLedgerSwitch.tsx`, `ObjectValidationsPanel.tsx`, and the field inspector's `DisplayPatchLock`.
- #32103's card body puts the field Move up in `ObjectFormCanvas.tsx`; on `main` those lines are the section arrows, and the field inspector's "Move up" with `title="Move up"` is `InspectorReorderButtons`. Both are fixed.

## Verification

<details><summary>Repro before (origin/main source, same test files)</summary>

`git restore --source=origin/main` on the seven source files (the five components and the two catalogues), then the five pinned test files: `Tests 8 failed | 98 passed (106)`. Each card's new pin is red for the defect: no description on the disabled button (`describedBy(...)` is `null`), no `role="tooltip"` on hover or focus, and the reorder arrow still carries `title`. #32105 against `main`'s `ResourceEditPage.tsx`: `expect(element).toHaveAccessibleName()` expected `Save`, received `No changes to save`. Restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, `git diff HEAD` empty. The CONTROL cases pass on `main` and after.

</details>

<details><summary>After</summary>

The five pinned files plus the eight updated suites: `Test Files 13 passed (13)`, `Tests 149 passed (149)`; `ResourceEditPage.serverRefusalGate.test.tsx`: `Tests 15 passed (15)`.

Every app-shell test file that names these controls or Save (27 files, found by grepping for the reorder, group, section and Save names, `resource-save` and "Save as draft"), on the merged head after a rebuild: `Test Files 27 passed (27)`, `Tests 260 passed (260)`. A whole-package `vitest run packages/app-shell/` was started and stopped after about an hour (2,225 files on a shared box); before it stopped it had flagged four files, all fixed above (the seven Save suites, `createAppAccessibleName`, which held a node across the submit turning on and is why the wrapper keeps one element tree, and `displayPatchReason-28986`). NOT MEASURED locally: the rest of the package, which CI's `Test UI` runs.

`pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell --filter @object-ui/i18n run type-check`: exit 0 (both `tsc --noEmit` and `tsconfig.test.json`), on the merged head.

</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

Head `e1fe6667` (after merging `origin/main`), recorded in the project gates file `card-32103/gates-e1fe6667.txt`. Every family `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives for this diff (37), plus `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`, `pnpm --dir ui run check:spec-symbols`, `pnpm --dir ui run check:new-line-citations` (0 new) and `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD`: all `exit 0`. `--ran` reconciliation: 37 derived, 37 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. `check:test-source-alias` first went red on the edited suites (a lazy `@objectstack/lint` / `@objectstack/formula` load inside a clocked window); a fourth commit adds the module-top imports it prescribes. Every other family is CI's, read from this PR's check-runs.

</details>
